listing.detail: Type a GitHub username on bilko.run and get a hosted portfolio plus printable résumé built from that account's public repos only, ranked by recency and activity. Private repos are never read or shown. Free: your top project, rebuilt at most once a day when viewed. $5/yr: pick up to 12 public repos, refreshed daily.
listing.audience: Developers whose public GitHub activity should double as a portfolio.
talkingPoints: Type your GitHub username at bilko.run/projects/git-viewer/ — no install, no signup to see it.
Turns your public GitHub repos into a portfolio page and a print-ready résumé, ranked by recency and activity.
Public data only: private repos are never read or shown, and no GitHub token or account access is asked for.
Free shows your top project, rebuilt at most once a day when someone views it.
$5/yr lets you pick up to 12 of your public repos and refreshes them daily.
listing.callToAction: Type your GitHub username at https://bilko.run/projects/git-viewer/
avoidClaims: Updates instantly when you push code
Shows more than one project on the free tier
Shows, reads or includes private repositories
Needs access to your GitHub account or a token from you
Fully free with no paid tier
